checks: paired syntax and compiled controls; external receipts
cost: O(N) traversal plus numeric costs; aggregate O(k log k); exact probability enumeration O(T*2^T) for T<=16. Trace size includes formatted intermediates; stack/allocation unbounded. Gate tolerance is policy, not universal numerical assurance.
description: Quantity evaluation and independent answer gate
forward: eval recursively produces Q and appends Ctx evidence. Exact pairs use Rat; mixed approximate pairs use f64. Aggregates convert to first operand units. answer uses fresh context then gate checks independent fcheck SI value and recorded booleans.
inverse: Output Q admits many Expr/environment/trace antecedents and equivalent units. Fixed-scale exact conversion has unique inverse only when all arithmetic succeeds. Gate accepts SI-equivalent representations, not a unique syntax or provenance.
limitations: Partial lexical projection; no semantic proof
